verdict.rationale: Dagster explicitly supports checking whether an asset's data needs refreshing via asset checks, and Dagster+ alerts can notify users of critical events (e.g., missed schedules) so freshness/cadence issues surface proactively; schedules/sensors/declarative automation provide the cadence framework to compare actual vs expected update times. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of freshness-check alerting in production use, and a dedicated 'freshness policy' example beyond the generic asset-check description.
